It’s been almost 19 years since Apple released the original iPhone. And I’ve always wanted to do a deep dive on each generation. So let’s start today, with the original model from 2007. Which is causally referred to as the iPhone 2G. But its official name was, and continues to be; ‘iPhone.’ Now to truly appreciate what made the first iPhone special, you have to understand
the smartphone market prior to its release.
title: History of the Original iPhone
